source_text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
child_paraphrase: Let your light shine so people can see the good things you do, and thank God.
license_note: Short quotation of the 1769 Oxford King James Version. That edition is public domain in the United States. No bulk copyrighted Bible text is used.
lock_note: Issue #6 Mission 1 lock. Approved 4-page prototype canon remains the source for Shine Your Light.
forbidden_claims: Do not invent extra narrative as scripture
Do not treat activity-book props such as lanterns, pumpkins, or fall scenes as facts from this verse
Do not add verses, names, or events that are not in Matthew 5:16
